2610.13765.title: When Edge Independence Fails: Joint Graph Diffusion with Latent Sociability Priors
2610.13765.paper_summary: Discrete graph diffusion models corrupt graph structure through independent edge updates with a Markovian noise model. Combined with the exchangeability requirement on the output distribution, the terminal prior is necessarily an Erdős--Rényi (E-R) random graph. This has a fundamental consequence for unconditional graph generation without node features: in the large graph limit, any GNN denoiser applied to an E-R graph approximately outputs an E-R graph, making effective denoising difficult. In practice, generated graphs fail to recover meaningful node heterogeneity and higher-order structure. Previous models introduced specialized node features to compensate, framing this as an expressivity problem, while the role of the prior remained unexamined. We instead address the root cause by introducing the Latent Sociability Prior (LSP) and a join} diffusion process that co-evolves latent node sociability variables and graph structure, removing edge independence while preserving exchangeability. Unlike existing latent graph diffusion methods, the sociability mechanism requires no complex encoder: its sole role is to guide edge updates and preserve node heterogeneity throughout the trajectory. We validate our approach on multiple graph generation datasets and show that the proposed framework more accurately captures graph distributions than baseline methods without node features.
2610.13765.paper_summary_zh: 離散圖擴散模型通過獨立的邊更新與馬爾可夫噪聲模型來破壞圖結構。結合對輸出分佈的可交換性要求，終端先驗必然是一個厄爾多斯–雷尼 (E-R) 隨機圖。這對於沒有節點特徵的無條件圖生成有一個根本性的影響：在大圖極限下，對 E-R 圖應用的任何 GNN 去噪器大約都會輸出一個 E-R 圖，這使得有效去噪變得困難。在實踐中，生成的圖無法恢復有意義的節點異質性和高階結構。先前的模型引入了專門的節點特徵來彌補，將這視為一個表達能力問題，而先驗的角色則未受到檢視。我們則通過引入潛在社交性先驗 (LSP) 和一個共同擴散過程來解決根本原因，該過程共同演化潛在的節點社交性變量和圖結構，去除邊的獨立性，同時保留可交換性。與現有的潛在圖擴散方法不同，社交性機制不需要複雜的編碼器：其唯一的作用是指導邊的更新，並在整個過程中保留節點異質性。我們在多個圖生成數據集上驗證了我們的方法，並顯示所提出的框架比沒有節點特徵的基線方法更準確地捕捉圖分佈。
